name: BajBulk Catalog Editor
author: bajtimes

sections.description:
BajBulk Catalog Editor gives you full control over your WooCommerce product catalog directly from an intuitive, lightning-fast dashboard. Designed for stores of all sizes, it makes product updates, price adjustments, stock management, and CSV data migration quick, reliable, and frictionless.

Key Features

  • Fast Inline Table Editor: Edit product titles, SKUs, regular prices, sale prices, stock quantity, stock status, categories, and post statuses directly in the table with instant autosave.
  • Bulk Price Adjustments: Increase or decrease regular and sale prices by percentage (%) or fixed amount, set flat prices, and schedule or clear sale prices.
  • Bulk Stock Manager: Update stock levels, increase/decrease inventory counts, and toggle stock statuses (In Stock, Out of Stock, On Backorder) in batches.
  • CSV Import & Export Wizard: Export filtered selections or entire catalogs with custom column mapping. Import products with live validation.
  • 1-Click Product Duplicator: Clone single or multiple products with automatic SKU generation and taxonomy preservation.
  • Advanced Multi-Filter & Search: Filter products by keyword, SKU, category, tag, price range, stock status, and product type.
  • High Performance: Built with AJAX-based pagination to handle small and large WooCommerce catalogs smoothly without memory issues.
  • WooCommerce HPOS Compatible: Officially declared compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bajbulk-catalog-editor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via WordPress Admin (“Plugins” -> “Add New” -> “Upload Plugin”).
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce -> Bulk Editor in your WordPress admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes! Variable products and variations can be filtered, viewed, and edited directly within the inline editor.

Does this plugin support CSV Import and Export?

Yes, a full CSV Import and Export wizard with custom column mapping is included directly in the plugin.

Is this compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, the plugin officially declares compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS.
